findings.message: 15 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Admin Portal", "Menu Utama", "PUSAT KOMANDO SIRKULARITAS • KAMPUS UPJ", "Total Tersalurkan").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.
One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: 34 text blocks under 11px: Admin Portal 10px, Menu Utama 10px, Total Tersalurkan 10px, Nilai Sirkularitas 10px.
2 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 91px in "Setor vs Salur Mitra", 67px in "Tren Volume Pengumpulan Kertas".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: 12% of the first screen is strongly coloured.
findings.fix: Keep the screen neutral and spend colour on data and status: the studied screens sit near 3%, and only tinted styles reach 10–15%, as pale tints rather than saturated fills.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Monitoring Sirkularitas & Limbah Kertas" (screen 1, 88% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Hai Admin! Kertas HVS UPJ siap" (4px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
